claims.statement: Organization owners invite member/billing-manager/owner roles; owner or repository-admin member can invite outside collaboration to repositories. Membership, billing and repository access are distinct scopes, not interchangeable authority.
Profile access to organizations lists memberships; visible membership does not prove effective repository permissions or complete enterprise estate inventory.

Accepted membership may expose public profile,email,two-factor status,organization repository/access/activity and request-origin information to owners; this is conditional visibility, not collected private evidence.

Owners cannot see member IP addresses in organization audit log under explicit note; security-incident requests may return access details including IP. Do not turn conditional incident disclosure into routine audit API availability.
Organization membership defaults private and can be selectively publicized on profile; public visibility is not membership consent for external publication or granted repository access.
FPT/GHEC membership in enterprise-owned organization automatically confers enterprise membership/owner visibility under source. GHES parent wildcard does not extend this cloud conditional.

Leaving organization is linked available action, not executed removal or proven post-departure credential/access cleanup; role definitions,privacy rules and removal safeguards remain separate referenced sources.
